learningObjectives.korean: 가축 사료 급여 방법에 대해 묻고 대답할 수 있다.
learningObjectives.english: Can ask and answer questions about feeding livestock.
learningObjectives.nepali: पशुपक्षीलाई दानापानी खुवाउने तरिकाबारे सोधपुछ गर्न सक्नुहुनेछ।

learningObjectives.korean: 축사 청소 및 분뇨 처리를 설명할 수 있다.
learningObjectives.english: Can explain barn cleaning and manure disposal.
learningObjectives.nepali: गोठ सफा गर्ने र गोबर/मल व्यवस्थापनबारे व्याख्या गर्न सक्नुहुनेछ।

grammar1.meaningNp: ...गरेको अनुभव छ / छैन (विगतको अनुभव / Have / Have not experienced)
grammar1.explanationEn: Attaches to verbs to express having or not having the past experience of doing something.
grammar1.explanationNp: क्रियापदमा जोडिएर विगतमा कुनै कार्य गरेको अनुभव आफूसँग छ वा छैन भन्ने बताउन प्रयोग गरिन्छ।
grammar1.ruleNp: अन्त्यमा स्वरवर्ण भए '-ㄴ 적이 있다/없다', व्यञ्जनवर्ण (받침) भए '-은 적이 있다/없다' जोडिन्छ।

examples.english: Have you ever fed cows before?
I have never driven a tractor before.

words.english: to clean out / clear away manure

grammar2.meaningNp: ...गर्न लगाउनु / ...हुन दिनु (प्रेरणार्थक / To make or allow someone to do)
grammar2.explanationEn: Attaches to verbs to indicate causing or permitting someone else to do an action.
grammar2.explanationNp: क्रियापदमा जोडिएर अरू कसैलाई कुनै कार्य गर्न अह्राउनु वा अनुमति दिनु भन्ने जनाउँछ।

examples.english: Make sure the livestock drink enough water.
I made sure the barn is ventilated so it stays clean.
examples.nepali: गोठ सधैं सफा रहोस् भनेर हावा आउने बनाएँ।
